replication.target_description: Replication of Bateson (2012): LAPOP/AmericasBarometer 2010 community problem-solving frequency regressed on past-year crime victimization, with demographic covariates and country fixed effects; robust standard errors clustered by municipality.

n.sample_role: Participants. Candidate count 38020 is replication-included participants; final critical-model analytic N is not explicitly established.
n.exclusions: Not specified; materials mention further cleaning and recoding. Minimum viable sample size 1320 is a design/power quantity.
